description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget `BottomActionsNav` that provides a bottom navigation bar with actions such as navigating chapters, toggling notes, bookmarking, and adjusting font size. It uses Flutter's Material Components and integrates with application state via Provider.

classes.name: BottomActionsNav
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that renders a bottom navigation bar with controls for chapter navigation, bookmarking, font size adjustment, and notes toggle.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the bottom navigation bar, sets up destination icons and labels, and handles user interactions.

methods.name: _hasPrev
methods.description: Determines if there is a previous chapter available based on the current chapter ID.

methods.name: _hasNext
methods.description: Determines if there is a next chapter available based on the current chapter ID.
